summary: One saved facial expression: sparse control weights by track name, the left and right links, its menu label and where editing started.

exportId.doc: Six-character export ID used in built expression mods.

label.doc: The photo-mode menu text; absent means the preset's name.

controls.doc: Control (track) name → weight in (0, 1]; absent keys are at rest.

links.doc: Per left/right pair key, whether edits move both sides.

origin.doc: Where editing started: rest, an installed photo-mode expression, or another preset (provenance only).

from: the library's part_presets rows for the expressions feature
expression parts carried on collection looks
migration.how: Each row becomes a preset node with the same UUID and a new export ID, its revisions as entries at their original times; a look's expression part becomes a preset referenced by that look's row.
migration.dryRun: Row and revision counts read against planned; every part round-trips to the same canonical bytes.
migration.copy: The library is copied beside itself before anything is written.
